statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-48702 is an unbounded gzip decompression (OOM) flaw in rekor's server-side Alpine APK entry parsing at pkg/types/alpine/apk.go (Package.Unmarshal), reachable only via the rekor transparency log HTTP endpoints POST /api/v1/log/entries and POST /api/v1/log/entries/retrieve. The kyverno family images do not run a rekor transparency log server; rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the cosign signature-verification chain. The proposed-entry APK decompression path is never invoked.
